title: Picture grid with a +N tile; each opens large
gate: Gate A oracle-pictures-sent 74/75 (box cases 12/12) (the tiles: card#3, 10 parts; scripts/lib/cards.mjs), oracle-pictures-waiting 61/62 (box cases 17/18) (thumbnails in the composer, Remove on hover); oracle-picture-viewer 79/79 (box cases 18/19) and oracle-picture-viewer-rest 79/79 (box cases 18/19) (the viewer over the conversation and the details panel); behaviour 5 picture rules and 6 viewer rules; live parity/live/picture.json
evidence: A message's pictures look as the oracle's 1.0.3 grid (fixtures/states/oracle-pictures-sent, a version exception, docs/decisions/0008): components/Cards.tsx PictureTiles + styles/cards.css, in a row of their own above the message's bubble: square tiles 6 apart across the bubble's width (three of 156 at 600), radius 12; past three the third is dimmed and says +N (five: +3). Served through /api/chat//attachments/, live and from Barkpark's stored rows after a reload (npm run turn:live -- --picture, 2026-11-13: the bot named the square's colour; parity/live/picture.json). Waiting, pictures sit inside the composer as square thumbnails, 56 and 8 apart, a Remove button on the one under the pointer (components/Attachments.tsx; oracle-pictures-waiting). scripts/behaviour.mjs: 5 rules. A press on a sent tile opens our picture viewer at that picture, never a new tab (components/Viewer.tsx + styles/viewer.css, 1:1 with fixtures/states/oracle-picture-viewer, the second tile pressed, "2 / 5", and -rest, the +3 tile pressed, which opens the third, "3 / 5"; task-a58919378f43975d): over all right of the rail, the picture's name in a pill, Mark up, Download and Back to chat; under the picture its name and place, a strip of all the message's pictures (the shown one ringed), and a composer about the picture; the conversation's own composer is hidden meanwhile, keeping its room. The picture loads by the route its tile's loads (four picture types only, nosniff; Barkpark reads it only inside that conversation, so the same id under another conversation is a 404), and Download saves it from that route under the name it was sent with (Barkpark's stored row names it; a picture with no name is "image"). Escape and Back to chat close it, focus back on the tile. Behaviour: 1 of the 5 picture rules and 6 viewer rules (scripts/lib/picture-viewer.mjs), each failing on main. Drawn only, as captured, not working: Mark up image (does nothing, aria-disabled) and the viewer composer's send (it takes words and sends nothing), until each is captured working. The picture's own place in the viewer is a box case now (box:page › img#1, task-9350f7d5eee2c573) and fails, named here: ours sits in the middle of its 952x500 stage (y 194 at 760), the oracle's 19 lower (213 in both captures: 141 above it in the stage, 103 below), though the oracle's picture is centred across that same stage; no captured box centres it at 213, so no place is derived from the layout and none is fitted. Also missing: no arrow keys between pictures (not captured); the composer's thumbnails still do nothing. One or two pictures are not captured either (needs a send on the oracle; none left), so those layouts are ours. On 1.2.3 (decision 0010) the tiles and the thumbnails pass; the one miss in each state is the time row, which the stand-in face sets wider (F6): "Today 11:31 PM" 4.1 wide in pictures-sent, "Today 8:21 PM" 2.3 wide in pictures-waiting (T2).
